title: Legal components
description: Components copied from pinned upstream images, with their licenses and notices (scripts/legal-components.yaml).

stage.description: The Dockerfile stage it's copied from: a pinned FROM ... AS <stage> (install: image), the stage that builds or downloads it (install: go-install, source-build, or release), or base for files the base image ships outside any apt package.

install.description: image (default): copied from a pinned upstream image, recorded with its digest. go-install: built with `go install <module>@<version>` in its stage, recorded with the module, version, and go.sum hash from the binary's build info. source-build: compiled from a source archive in its stage, recorded with the archive URL and SHA-256 from /legal/attribution/<name>/SOURCE. release: unpacked from upstream's release archive in its stage, recorded with the archive URL and SHA-256 from /legal/attribution/<name>/SOURCE.

version.description: Command that prints the installed version; the first x.y[.z] in its output is used.

notices.description: Notice files in the image (globs). At least one must exist.

paths.description: Installed files and directories. The first is hashed for the SBOM; all count as accounted for in the unowned-executable check.

upstream.description: License files to fetch from GitHub at the installed version, when the image doesn't ship them. They go to /legal/attribution/<name>/.

tag.description: Tag pattern; {version} is replaced with the installed version. Quote it in YAML when it starts with {.

purl.description: Package URL for tools SBOM scanners can't identify on their own; {version} is replaced. Adds the component to /legal/sbom/devcontainer.cdx.json.
